**Section of the spec this is about**
e.g., §4.1 SeekerAgentCard / §5 consent grammar / §7.2 RPO worked example

**What you observed**
Describe the case, ambiguity, naming concern, or counterexample. Concrete examples beat abstract critique.

**What you'd expect or propose**
If you have a suggestion, please share it. If you don't, just say so — naming the problem clearly is also valuable.

**Your context (optional)**
A sentence or two about the perspective you're reading from (platform you build, jurisdiction, role, etc.). Only if relevant — anonymous feedback is fine.
